review_basis: Direct original-resolution inspection of the neighborhood, gymnasium and cultural PNG boards from the full live PNU run after additive program-profile/VLM synthesis lanes, executable section-graph phenotype measurement, measured wedge/pyramid caps and same-source legal/FAR/parking evaluation.

live_openai_vlm_evidence.interpretation: This proves the ArchDaily/VLM/typed-edit path executed and changed compiled geometry. It does not by itself prove that the final selected portfolio improved.

neighborhood.measured: 20/20, 15 BOOK principles, 16 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 3, oblique 1, prismatic 6, stepped 1, voided 6, winged 3; wedge 2, pyramid 2.
neighborhood.visual_verdict: Curved street bars, wings, steps and calm solids coexist, but courtyard/notched compact boxes recur too often and public-ground or tenant/circulation hierarchy is not resolved.
neighborhood.remaining_limit: Street frontage, tenant subdivision, vertical circulation and public-ground section remain unverified.

gymnasium.measured: 20/20, 12 BOOK principles, 19 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 3, oblique 6, prismatic 4, stepped 4, voided 2, winged 1; wedge 1, pyramid 2.
gymnasium.visual_verdict: The portfolio reads as the most program-specific: long-span bars, gable, shed, folded, barrel, sawtooth and stepped sections coexist. A few low rails and two convergent stepped bodies remain generic.
gymnasium.remaining_limit: Clear-span structure, daylight performance, entry/service circulation and spectator section remain unverified.

cultural.measured: 20/20, 18 BOOK principles, 16 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 2, oblique 1, prismatic 5, stepped 4, voided 4, winged 4; wedge 3, pyramid 2.
cultural.visual_verdict: Gallery wings, courtyard voids, paired blocks and stepped masses coexist, but several courtyard/chamfer/terrace bodies remain visually close to the neighborhood portfolio.
cultural.remaining_limit: Gallery sequence, art logistics, civic entry hierarchy and controlled daylight remain unresolved.

verdict: The full live ArchDaily + OpenAI VLM + typed outcome-graph loop executed, produced real compiled geometry revisions and retained all 60 same-source legal/FAR/parking passes. The additive control lane prevents VLM directives from erasing winged/oblique candidates, and corrected morphology measurement prevents complex topology or legacy roof graphs from hiding wedge/pyramid/phenotype repetition. Gym is now measurably program-distinct. Direct review still finds strong neighborhood-cultural compact courtyard/chamfer/terrace resemblance, so competition-grade completion is explicitly rejected.
